message.airjump.blocked: airjump is disabled on this server
options.airjump.title: airjump Settings
options.airjump.enabled.tooltip: Whether air jumps are available now. The toggle key switches the same setting. It has no effect on servers the multiplayer mode rules out.
options.airjump.singleplayer_default.too: The state restored in singleplayer worlds when a reset applies.
options.airjump.multiplayer_default.tool: The state restored on servers the multiplayer mode allows when a reset applies.
options.airjump.reset_on_world_exit.tool: Every world starts from its default state instead of keeping the last state.
options.airjump.reset_on_game_exit.toolt: After restarting the game, the first world where the mod is allowed starts from its default state.
options.airjump.multiplayer_mode.whiteli: Active only on servers in the server list.
options.airjump.multiplayer_mode.blackli: Active on all servers except those in the server list.
options.airjump.edit_servers.tooltip: Edit the addresses used by the whitelist and blacklist modes.
options.airjump.servers.title: Server List
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.airjump: Lets the local player jump in mid-air.
